scope: Three additive documentary records only. Preserve earlier packets, institutional register, formal response forms and the complete private audit tree. No participant-value parsing, contacts or assumed approvals.
negative_control_method: In-memory clones of the parsed acceptance JSON had each of 26 held authority flags flipped to true, then formal rights approval, institutional adoption, reviewer assignment, automatic workflow adoption or disposition invented individually. Held-state validator rejected all 31 mutations; no fixture files created.
review_method: Same-agent exact source-to-snapshot string comparison, JSON parsing, byte/SHA-256 verification, explicit content/status checks, in-memory negative controls and preservation scans. Not independent human/institutional review, participant-data review, source authentication or legal determination.
snapshot_provenance: Complete substantive immediately preceding R12 account retained with historical pending-acceptance question and no-change statement framed as earlier-turn wording. No platform-authenticated export or message identifier available.

proposed_commit.title: docs: record documentary acceptance of R12 controlled-adoption account
description: Preserve the full consolidated R12 account and record the author's exact documentary acceptance dated 25 October 2026.
Conclude the author documentary clarification without adopting a formal institutional response or resolving the underlying rights, ethics, privacy, scientific or operational gates.

Keep oral institutional conclusions distinct from written or external committee approval. Retain unknown narrowed-package coverage and the distinction between no recalled conditions and unrestricted permission.

Preserve truthful-reporting rules for consent, review chronology, funding, data availability and actual version approvals. Do not rewrite historical consent documents or approve final manuscript wording.
Keep participant data restricted, the academic submission version non-public and the new package unpublished pending its exact-version approval and applicable checks.
Retain the user's scientific decision authority and leave qualitative permissions outside this quantitative review.
Require separately scoped authorization for further actions; infer no coauthor/institutional approval, submission permission or release authority.
Validate 41 content/status checks and 31 negative controls, including exact accepted-text comparison.
Verify unchanged preservation fingerprints for all 1,270 pre-existing tracked files and 23,281 private audit files.
No participant inspection, contacts, fitting, analysis/manuscript changes, licence application, cleanup, commit, push, synchronization, submission or release.

completion_boundary: Only documentary acceptance recording and its audit complete. Formal R12 and D1_rights institutional responses remain pending. No approval, exemption, verified consent coverage, legal conclusion, disclosure clearance or permission for later action supplied. No next task automatically initiated.

preservation.method: Two complete scans: existing absolute paths sorted case-sensitively; SHA-256 of UTF-8 concatenation absolute_path TAB byte_length TAB uppercase_file_SHA256 LF. Extended Windows paths used. Counts, byte totals and digests match in both groups.
preservation.scope_limit: Local pre-existing tracked files and complete private audit-local tree only. Opaque hashing did not parse participant values; no data-bearing Git revisions, remote copies, access controls or third-party copies inspected. New records separately hashed outside preservation groups. Audit does not self-hash.
